title: The Steam Machine design makes for a frightfully good tissue box, and now you can 3D print your own
summary: Maybe useful to catch our tears over memory prices right now.
body: Achoo! Sorry, my hayfever's been playing up again. Let me just grab a tissue from my Steam Machine... is something you could be saying if you're willing to 3D print the replica this generous individual over on Reddit designed and shared. The Steam Machine Style Tissue Box Cover (or 'Enclosure') is, practically speaking, just a tissue box. But I'll be damned if I'm not tempted to buy a 3D printer just to make one. It looks very much like a real Steam Machine, sans all the actual gubbins that makes it, well, the real thing . You can download the 3D files from MakerWorld and have one of your own. Quake 4: Awakening was being developed at Ritual Entertainment—creators of the soon to be remastered SiN and its aborted episodic sequel—but the project was canned by Activision due to underwhelming sales of the base game. title: Roblox shares plummet by 70% after the company reports persistent decline in player numbers, and of course the solution involves AI
summary: The company's earnings outlook for the remaining year has "changed considerably."
body: The seemingly unstoppable force that is Roblox might not be so unstoppable after all. The company share price has dropped by 70% following the publication of its second-quarter earnings, which show a decline in players and lower-than-expected monetisation. In an earnings call (via Games Industry ) Roblox CFO Naveen Chopra said the company attributed the shortfall to a dearth of "vintage viral games", with players shifting attention to "new and evergreen experiences with lower hourly monetisation". This was exacerbated by changes in Roblox's recommendation algorithm, which Chopra says "optimises for long-term retention" at the expense of "near-term monetisation". While Roblox still has an enormous audience of 123 million daily players, this number has declined steadily across the previous three quarters from a high of 152 million. Monthly unique players have also fallen by 10 million in the last two quarters, with the number currently at 27 million. Roblox doesn't expect these winds to change in the near future, either. A self-billed "melancholic first-person parkour adventure," it looks like the moody stepchild of Mirror's Edge. A new trailer for the game dropped last month and revealed it comes out Aug. 21. It provides a sneak peek at the game's overgrown, brutalist jungle gyms and shows off Vholume's multiplayer. According to its Steam page , you can race your buds in real time or compete against their ghosts.
